column1: # Title: Country-level supply curves of municipal solid waste (MSW) for the GCAM-Europe Eurostat countries
# Units: maxSubResource: EJ/yr; mid-price: 1975$/GJ; curve-exponent and gdpSupplyElast: unitless
# Description: One row per region in gcameurope.EUROSTAT_COUNTRIES (37 regions). Column region_GCAM3 holds the GCAM-Europe region name (GCAM_region_names region)
column2: not a GCAM 3.0 region. maxSubResource: maximum amount of MSW production in the base year; mid-price: price at which half of maxSubResource is produced; curve-exponent: shape parameter of the S-curve supply function; gdpSupplyElast: elasticity of maxSubResource to GDP. Curve-shape parameters are the GCAM 3.0 values and are the same in all rows. Belarus and Switzerland are not in this table and keep the core GCAM 3.0 values (energy/A13.MSW_curves downscaled by GDP).
